scoring_justification: Paper reports results only as graphs; hidden exact gold values are unavailable. Scoring checks sign, monotonic temperature trend, inter-reaction ordering, and approximate magnitude ranges consistent with paper's curves.

output_contract.notes: All thermochemical data must be obtained from publicly available databases such as NIST‑JANAF. Phase transition temperatures (particularly for fluorides) are approximate and should be taken from standard handbooks; the paper notes a 1000–1100 °C range for fluoride melting/boiling points.
